_doc: Gemma4-31B bf16 APC-OFF + chunked-prefill-OFF ablation on p5.48xlarge (8×H100). Replicates the 2026-07-09 bf16 tpot-detail run's serving config EXCEPT the two scheduler-level optimizations that vLLM-Neuron doesn't support on Gemma4 yet are flipped OFF: --no-enable-prefix-caching AND --no-enable-chunked-prefill. Everything else stays exactly matched (image v0.20.0-cu130-ubuntu2404, fp8 KV, CUDA graphs on-by-omission — Neuron NEFFs are the graph-capture equivalent so BOTH stay on-graph, --compilation-config fuse_allreduce_rms+eliminate_noops on dp==1, --language-model-only, --generation-config vllm, random dataset with random_range_ratio 0.0, num_prompts=1280 warmups=512 at conc=256). Purpose: strict matched-config-to-Neuron-feature-set comparison, isolating the scheduler-optimization contribution to Gemma4's July 9 headline numbers.

models._compilation_note: Matches the 2026-07-09 baseline's dp==1 compilation flags exactly. The dp>1 cells (tp4_dp2, tp2_dp4, tp1_dp8) omit the flag — the earlier run did the same because fuse_allreduce_rms hangs at DP>1 on Gemma4 v0.20.0.

regimes.name: bf16_noapc_nochunked
regimes._doc: bf16 weights, fp8 KV cache, no spec, APC OFF, chunked prefill OFF. The two scheduler-level optimizations vLLM-Neuron currently lacks on Gemma4. Identical to the 2026-07-09 baseline's bf16 regime on every other dimension.

_shardings: Full TP×DP sweep to match the baseline. No EP (Gemma4-31B is dense).
_concurrencies: Conc=256 only per user request. This is the single concurrency the ablation targets.
_workload: Random with random_range_ratio 0.0 (exact 1024/512 shapes) matches the baseline byte-for-byte. num_prompts = 256*5 = 1280, warmups = 256*2 = 512 — same as the baseline at conc=256. Intentionally NOT sharegpt: matched-config with a prior sharegpt-free baseline is the whole point of this ablation.
_server: enable_prefix_caching=false AND enable_chunked_prefill=false are the TWO flips vs baseline — the scheduler-level optimizations vLLM-Neuron currently lacks on Gemma4. Harness emits --no-enable-prefix-caching (explicit) and omits --enable-chunked-prefill (i.e. leaves vLLM at its non-chunked default). CUDA graphs stay on-by-omission because vLLM-Neuron's execution model IS graph-capture (AOT-compiled NEFFs) — disabling graphs would misrepresent both platforms. dp==1 compilation flags (fuse_allreduce_rms+eliminate_noops) also stay on for tp8, matching the baseline. max_num_seqs=512 and max_num_batched_tokens=8192 pinned to match the baseline (harness default would have derived ~2048 for isl=1024). --language-model-only + --generation-config vllm carried via extra_flags. --kv-cache-dtype fp8, --trust-remote-code, --no-enable-log-requests, --seed 0 all come from sweep_bench.py's defaults or the regime.kv_cache_dtype override.
